subject: Contract traffic-control: sequencing MAP + MSA/DPA/orderform dependencies
messages:
From: Ben Russell <ben.russell@avahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sequencing draft + deliverables (SOW + order form attached)

Marcus / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with latency and cost breakdown tooling. Procurement at Ava wants to lock in a clear sequencing plan so legal and finance can align. I attached a draft SOW and your order form template (both as stubs).

High level ask: can you deliver a mutual action plan (MAP) that stitches together:
- MSA signature timing and conditions (legal redlines + Escalation contact)
- DPA review and cert gating (data retention & subprocessor list)
- Order form (pricing, committed capacity, start date)
- Acceptance criteria / pilot evaluation period (2 weeks recommended)

Target: Ava would like a signature window in the first half of June. Procurement has an internal finance freeze the week of 6/21 — we'd like to be live before that.

Attachments: AVA_SOW_draft_v2.pdf (SOW stub), redwood_orderform_template.xlsx (orderform stub)

Next steps I propose: you send a MAP with milestones and owners; if legal needs a redline tracker we can run DocuSign for countersigned MSA & Order Form.

Ben
Ben Russell
Sr. Procurement Manager, Ava Health
procurement@avahealth.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Russell <ben.russell@avahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sequencing draft + deliverables (SOW + order form attached)

Ben — thanks for the clear asks and the draft SOW. Appreciate the target window; we should be able to meet an early-June signature cadence with a tight sequence.

Quick sketch of a MAP (we'll formalize in a shared spreadsheet / HubSpot activity):
1) Legal redline pass (MSA + DPA) — Redwood legal (Karthik Iyer) to produce first redline within 5 business days of receiving Ava redlines. Target: complete by 2027-05-18.
2) Order form lock (pricing & committed GPUs) — Sales Ops (Laura Bennett) to confirm SKU & billing cadence; target lock by 2027-05-20.
3) Pilot eval window (2-week pilot) — Start as soon as order form countersigned; acceptance criteria: latency p95 < 200ms for test dataset; cost checkpoint within 15% of forecast.
4) Final signatures (MSA + Order Form) — target signature window 2027-06-01 to 2027-06-10.
5) DPA & security checklist — provide SOC2 evidence, subprocessor list within 3 business days of request; target closure 2027-05-25.

I'll do two things this week: (A) loop in Karthik to confirm detailed DPA items and anticipated redlines; (B) ask Laura to lock the order form fields and produce a populated orderform for Ava to sign. If anything slips, we propose a fallback: staged capacity (pilot-only start) to be live with limited token cap while full orderform finalizes.

Ben — can you confirm procurement's internal "finance freeze" date and whether the 6/21 freeze is a hard cutover? Also, are there any internal reviewers (security, legal) we should add to the MAP?

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Ava MAP draft — legal checklist + orderform population (please action)

Team — moving this to internal thread so we can lock owners and dates. I forwarded Ben's note below. Short, practical asks:

Karthik — want you to do a quick triage on likely DPA redlines (encryption at rest, subprocessor disclosures, incident notification SLA). Can you:
- Confirm whether Redwood's standard DPA covers Ava's retention ask (30 months) or if we need a custom carve-out
- Produce a redline pass on the attached MSA/DPA mock (I attached AVA_SOW_draft_v2.pdf for context)
- Flag any gating SOC2 evidence we can't provide within the 2-week target

Please aim to have the redline pass and gating list by 2027-05-13 EOD so Marcus can share with Ava and keep the signature window. If it looks like legal timeline slips beyond 5 business days, call it out immediately.

Laura — can you populate redwood_orderform_template.xlsx with: committed capacity, billing cadence, pilot discount, and a placeholder start date of 2027-06-01? Target: 2027-05-12 EOD. Also include the SKU mapping and a summary of token-based vs seat-based billing so Ava can pick. We'll keep the pilot as optional fallback if full commitment is delayed.

Once we have both artifacts (redline + populated orderform) I'll assemble a one-page MAP (owner / milestone / date / acceptance criteria) and share it with Ben.

Thanks — Marcus
